title: Le Maison Blanc | KEY.co
description_expanded: Every home is well equipped with linens on each bed, as well as an extra set for any sleeper sofas that may be in the home. Each bathroom is stocked appropriately with bath towels, hand towels, wash cloths, and bath mats to accommodate the sleeping capacity of the home. There are starter sets of soap, detergent, dish soap, and toilet paper there for your convenience. Kitchens are each stocked with enough dishes, serving pieces, glassware, and all the other kitchen necessities to prepare meals during the guests stay. We provide a starter set of laundry detergent for our guests to use when they arrive. Outdoors, the main pool and shallow wading pool create a family-friendly oasis, while the dock invites fishing, kayaking, and sunset lounging just steps from your door. Inside, eight spacious bedrooms ensure everyone has room to unwind, including multiple king suites with private balconies and bay views. Despite its peaceful waterfront setting, the white-sand beaches of the Gulf are just five minutes away. Whether you're planning a family gathering, a celebration, or a serene getaway, this bayfront estate promises a luxurious stay surrounded by natural beauty and resort-style amenities.
